title: 08 · Made with OpenDesigner: launch post
strengths: The work is the proof: one headline in Hanken Grotesk with the second line highlighted by weight only, cobalt used once in the lockup, and a mosaic of real renders bleeding off the right and bottom

The tiles are a true mix (an ocean observatory, a podcast app, a fashion editorial, a watch face, a cassette player, a clinic, a calendar) with 1 px lines and no shadow, so the mosaic reads as evidence rather than decoration
slop_signals: The second row is cut at about 40% of its height, so the card reads as a crop of a longer page rather than a deliberate bleed
The tiles have mixed aspect ratios and the right bleed cuts the Pomelo and Wayfern tiles at different points, which loosens the grid
fixes: Show at least 60% of the second row, or stop the mosaic on a tile edge and let only the right side bleed
Align the right-hand cut so both rows end at the same x

references.what: Two rows of site tiles bleeding off both edges with the headline below; the rows are cut at the same point on each side
'Made with Squarespace' at the centre of a wall of real sites; the work carries the claim
Headline above a grid of site thumbnails cut off at the bottom; the same device, with the cut landing lower so the second row still reads
A giant three-line 'MADE WITH SQUARESPACE' with one site card; the loud alternative to our quiet headline

owner.said: Hide all 6: approved the round 4 audit's removals (mockups showing removed pieces, heroes repeating the product screens, a generic timer)

round3.audited_by: fresh-context agent (did not build it), then a fresh check of the fixes
changed: Rendered last, with every tile at its piece's final render
Alt texts: Voltfield (Tempo 6 x 800 is the workout), Calamondin Tapes, Fellrise
Phone tiles cropped on whole elements (Undertow 12.3%, Voltfield 15.4%)
Trail watch brought onto the canvas; both rows end at the same point; watch tiles swapped so the edge cuts Tidemark through its sea
remaining: Minor: aria-label on a plain div; the Voltfield alt text is longer than the others; '2.1 km' sits above '2.1 m rising'

owner_history.said: when designs are bad, mockups will also be bad; work on them
